usedFor: CompanyCam holds job site projects, photos and comments, and Conversion Chats sends a message about them with “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Added To Project” in CompanyCam, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A contact added to a project gets a template message, sent through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: “Send Template Message” reaches someone outside your business, so the message waits for your approval before it goes out.
